narr: Thunderstorms developed along a trough ahead of a cold front. One of these storms produced large hail. More storms formed along the cold front some of which produced locally heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding in Lytle. Several roads were flooded including Benton City Rd., CR 681, and FM 2790.
lsr: ONGOING FLOODING AT SEVERAL LOCATIONS IN LYTLE. BENTON CITY ROAD/FM 3175, HIGH SCHOOL CR 681, LAKE SHORE ESTATES, AND FM 2790.
